violated_contract: A key-validation attempt that produces no provider verdict (transport failure, timeout, provider 5xx/429, offline) must not be treated as a rejection of the key. Collapsing the two into one failure status let a single offline launch or provider blip deactivate a BYOK enrollment server-side while the key text stayed visible in Settings: the surface looked configured, every later request silently rode the managed lane into billing 402s, and the only recovery was re-saving the key once the network returned.
canonical_prevention: Classify validation outcomes into provider verdicts (ok, rejected) and non-verdicts (transient) before any activation/teardown decision. Activate or deactivate enrollments only on verdicts; on a non-verdict, keep the existing enrollment and tell the user the check can be retried. Badge copy must distinguish 'Invalid' from 'Check failed'.
